cores.textbox: You may play this from your banished zone.{br}**Blood Debt**

faces.printed_rules_text:
You may play Void Wraith from your banished zone.
**Blood Debt** _(At the beginning of your end phase, if Void Wraith is in your banished zone, lose 1{h}.)_
